jornada-ia.titulo: From chat to agent: the overview

inicio.kicker: Course · step 4 of the From chat to agent program · 8 lessons
inicio.titulo: Social media on autopilot, with sources on screen
inicio.lead: A reel in 7 steps, videos for different audiences, and a channel in your niche that watches the top performers, checks every number, and publishes only what you approved. In eight lessons, you’ll build the whole workflow: rules, a source-backed knowledge base, a checked script, a schedule, and a gate.
inicio.capa_alt: An editing desk with a 9:16 phone, a source table, and a calendar: the workflow for a channel with sources on screen.
inicio.aulas_sub: Follow the workflow: start with the script, then set up the rules and source-backed knowledge base, check the script, make videos for different audiences, and finish with the schedule and gate.

itens: Anyone who has completed steps 1–3 (terminal, your own assistant, and queue) and wants to bring that work to social media.
Professionals and creators in a niche who want to post regularly without making up numbers.
Anyone who guides teams or clients and needs a responsible method for automating content.

blocos.t: What you’ll be able to do
itens: Write a reel in 7 steps from a plan with a potential score.
Create canais.md, regras.md, and base.md for your niche, with the exact passage behind each number.
Ask the agent for a 60-second script and flag anything that doesn’t match the knowledge base.
Write the schedule (timer) and run it for a week with a gate, turning every rejection into a rule.
